checks: Checked 6b3596acb8604c8b §5 and the use of the uniform barycentric area measure.
The lower and upper vertex triangle probabilities follow by multiplying edge intercept ratios, also when x=y for the upper branch and y=z for the lower branch.
Independently checked the derivative numerator for the upper branch and G(c*)=c*/z. For z>0, c*−y=x(1−y/z)≥0 and z−c*=(z−x)(z−y)/z≥0.

The lower branch is decreasing or constant at x=0, and the ratio is the threshold above z. When x=y=0<z the limit is zero. When y=z>x, the minimum value is z; the constant row formula handles the final tie including all zero.

overlap.comparison: Gives continuity for any row law, without the exact uniform-triangle formula.
Covers the full-threshold optimum when the positive row has a repeated top or is constant. It does not compute the proper threshold or zero-entry cases.
Its proof covers the zero-row entries by the geometric mean or zero formulas, which are proper subcases of this closed formula.

readability: The statement only gives the minimum value, so the flat lower interval when x=0 does not require uniqueness.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The scalar formula is exact at all sorted nonnegative rows, with direct treatment of equal and zero knots.
